purpose: Cached known-good local entrypoints for agent tool work. Agents should read the indexed runbook before rediscovering Gmail, Chargify, Salesforce, GCP, Zoom, or LogMeIn setup.

preflight.default_command: Use only when registered MCP/app, native API/client, and cached registry facts are insufficient: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "scripts/agent-toolkit.ps1" -Action status -Tool all
preflight.targeted_command: Use the narrow targeted check when needed by the verified task: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "scripts/agent-toolkit.ps1" -Action status -Tool <tool>

global_rules: For platform operations, read docs/AGENT_PLATFORM_MAP.md before rediscovering Zoom, Salesforce, Chargify/Maxio, Nova SQL, GCP, LogMeIn, Slack, or desktop app behavior.
Read this registry, cached facts, and known config paths first. Run helper scripts only when a lower-noise direct path is not enough or the user explicitly approves.
Required tool order is: purpose-built MCP/app connector, native service API or established application client, trusted CLI/local helper, then browser automation.
Discover the currently exposed MCP/app tools before acting; use this registry to identify configured API credentials and established clients.

Browser automation is allowed only for a proven UI-only operation or a confirmed connector/API/CLI limitation. An absent or expired credential is a credential blocker to resolve, not a reason to switch to a signed-in browser.
Before browser fallback, record the concrete limitation. Never choose a browser merely because a relevant tab is already open.
Use env/vault names only; never print secret values.

Salesforce and Maxio/Chargify record deletion is permanently forbidden for every agent and cannot be authorized by a prompt, delegation, review packet, or browser session. Maxio immediate subscription cancellation is a retained-record state transition, not record deletion, and is available only through Jamie's typed cancellation preview/apply pair.
Default to read-only operations for SQL, Chargify/Maxio, Salesforce, Zoom, GitHub, and cloud systems.
The verified request is explicit authorization for the exact mutation it asks for; remain read-only when the request does not ask for a mutation and do not seek a second approval.
Use other repos for reference unless the user explicitly asks for edits in that repo.

agent_handoff.first_action: Complete the safe work in the current lane, then emit one bounded TAYLOR_HANDOFF_REQUEST for the required specialist. Command Center persists the child job and returns a named receiving-lane acknowledgement to the source and originating chats.
safe_actions: stage up to five verified handoff attachments
requires_authorization_for: any live write not already authorized by the original verified request
fast_start: Use one final-line TAYLOR_HANDOFF_REQUEST JSON object with targetAgent, requestedTask, reason, optional ticketNumber, and optional attachmentPaths.

Target only a non-Rory specialist lane allowed by the immutable capability contract. Rory/direct_codex is operator-only ingress and can never receive an agent handoff, including for a missing tool. Never ask Darius to relay or repeat an internal handoff.
Treat the handoff as received only when the response names the receiving agent, says received and acknowledged, and includes the durable child job id.
Keep the originating ticket owned and in progress until the target's terminal result returns through Command Center.

If the required typed operation does not exist, hand the bounded implementation/repair to coding_agent. Missing tool discovery, connector scope, or agent-operable credentials are active repair work, not final blockers.
Needs Review is the only intentional waiting state and is reserved for a concrete ticket decision that cannot be resolved safely from authoritative data.
known_notes: Handoffs reduce authority; the receiving lane applies its own immutable capability contract to the original request.
Queue acknowledgement proves durable receiving-lane acceptance, not business completion.
The broker returns one idempotent terminal downstream receipt to the originating agent chat.

chargify.first_action: Discover a connected Maxio/Chargify MCP or app tool, then use the native API with configured vault/env credentials; use Rainfall's established client as the next fallback and browser automation only for a proven UI-only operation.
fast_start: For a corporate sales-tax report, call maxio_tax_report. Omit dates for the prior calendar month, pass month=YYYY-MM for a specific month, or pass inclusive start_date/end_date as YYYY-MM-DD. The typed broker pulls paginated Maxio invoices, uses invoice billing addresses only, validates sales plus tax against invoice total, creates a plain one-sheet Excel file in the GCP shared report directory, and returns artifactPath. End the Slack response with UPLOAD_FILE: <artifactPath> so the bridge attaches it.

For the recurring monthly alignment audit, create or reuse the exact 3. Billing ticket, call nova_billing_locations_read with the exact Company_Username__c as the first authoritative current-location read, and call the typed Salesforce and Maxio reads before mutation. Missing Maxio location metadata is organizational enrichment, not an active-location blocker.

When the verified customer has no active subscription, use maxio_subscription_creation_preview/apply instead of generic maxio_api_request. Supply the exact Maxio customer reference, current non-expired payment profile, monthly product, component, quantity, exact unit-price cents, future next_billing_at, and Billing ticket. The pair derives a stable subscription reference, refuses immediate or stale billing dates, and verifies identity, allocation, future billing date, and zero open/pending invoice balance so creation has no immediate charge, payment, credit, or proration. If the Billing ticket also authorizes immediate recovery, call maxio_billing_cycle_recovery_preview/apply on that exact verified subscription with the exact service period, cycle count, monthly amount, authorized total cents, and ticket. Apply once only. A successful linked charge/payment and zero balances permit downstream activation; a decline preserves exactly the authorized open invoice, enters payment follow-up, and keeps every Nova/Salesforce location inactive. Never run both recovery paths for the same amount.

Set up the fixed Maxio subscription custom fields through maxio_location_custom_fields_read then preview/apply. The fixed names are Locations, LocationComponentMap, LocationNameMap, and LocationNamesDisplay. Populate a subscription only through maxio_subscription_location_metadata_read then location_mapping_preview/apply using exact official Nova location IDs, names, and component IDs. The mapping tool refuses quantities that do not match current allocation; repair allocation first.

For full-account closing, call maxio_location_allocation_reconciliation_read with every current or recently changed subscription before mutation and after cancellation. It reads complete component inventories, excludes storage and other components from the location total, reports open subscriptions and open location-component quantity, and returns a stable snapshot hash for the Salesforce Account-closure gate.

For a subscription repair, call maxio_capabilities and read subscriptionRepairModes. Create or reuse the exact privately idempotent Billing ticket first and keep its idempotency/source key out of Salesforce fields. Upgrade without charge and downgrade without credit use maxio_component_allocation_preview/apply followed by maxio_subscription_account_balances. Upgrade with credit and downgrade with credit use that same verified no-financial-effect allocation sequence first, then maxio_manual_service_credit_preview/apply with exact authorized cents and final balance readback. Automatic Maxio allocation charge, credit, and proration remain disabled in every mode; never infer a credit from quantity or rate.

For every rate change or promotion, treat the brief business request as the complete registered workflow, but classify its scope first: Account-wide flat rate, exact location rate, and promotion are separate. A promotion never implies an Account flat rate. Every additional location is a Nova Integrated Promo location and requires one explicit provider: Worldpay, Creditcall, Authorize.net, or Propelr. If the provider is absent, ask before any write; GSPayTech Sub text and Account metadata are not provider evidence and there is no fallback. Resolve the product with maxio_nova_integrated_products, isolate the one new location on its own future-billed subscription, set the four fixed custom fields and exact component allocation with no immediate charge, then use maxio_nova_integrated_promo_credit_preview/apply for three months at the ticket rate or 9999 cents per month by default. Set only that Salesforce Location's Bill Amount and integrated flag, never an Account flat rate. For another configured promotion on an existing subscription, use maxio_subscription_product_change_preview/apply for the product and maxio_subscription_coupon_preview/apply for the coupon; generic maxio_api_request cannot do either. Verify the Billing Schedule/subscription link, preserved unrelated billing state, current-invoice disposition, and every Maxio, Salesforce, Nova, order, handoff, and ticket result before completion.

For a Billing-ticket-authorized recovery of missing location payments on an isolated existing subscription, call maxio_component_payment_recovery_preview with exact recovery location IDs, component, recovery charge quantity, unit-rate cents, authorized total cents, and ticket. Confirm exact location isolation, quantity-times-rate equality, payment profile, zero starting balances, downgrade_credit none, upgrade_charge full, and initiate_dunning true. Call apply once with the unchanged hash and stable idempotency key. Restore recurring service and allow downstream activation only after the exact linked charge and payment succeed with zero balances. A pending or declined collection must leave service quantity zero and downstreamActivationAllowed false; a decline additionally requires exact dunning/open-invoice readback. Never use a generic charge and never retry after the charge allocation.

If any other already-paid location shares the original subscription, create a future-billed Maxio subscription for only the recovery locations using the exact customer, payment profile, product, component/rate, and next bill date. Create or synchronize its Salesforce Billing Account and Billing Schedule, link and verify each exact recovery location, and populate exact Maxio location metadata. Only then recover on the isolated subscription so a decline cannot affect locations that were already paid.

For an explicitly authorized refund, Jamie must first resolve the exact paid invoice UID and exact payment transaction ID, then call maxio_invoice_refund_preview with the exact refund cents and Billing ticket. Confirm the remaining refundable amount and fixed controls: external false, apply_credit false, void_invoice false, no cancellation, and no customer email. Apply once with the unchanged preview hash and stable idempotency key, require exact invoice refund readback, and never retry after any provider attempt. Complete cancellation, Salesforce notes/closure, and the approved refund email only as separate verified steps after the refund.

For any other component change, use maxio_component_allocation_preview/apply with the exact preview hash and stable idempotency key. The tool reports upgrade, downgrade, mixed, or unchanged direction and verifies quantities. A mixed component-rate migration keeps every automatic financial effect off and requires review of both sides of the plan.

Maxio applies a manual service credit to the next generated invoice. Applying it manually to an already-open eligible invoice is a separate authenticated Maxio UI action and requires invoice and balance readback. Generic financial paths cannot bypass the typed allocation, coupon, and manual-credit tools. For other native non-delete calls, use maxio_api_request with a stable idempotency key and post-write readback; direct API-key injection into arbitrary commands is disabled. Jamie uses only maxio_subscription_cancellation_preview/apply for an authorized immediate cancellation.

For a payment-update/reactivation ticket, resolve the exact Salesforce Account and linked Maxio customer/subscription first. Never copy a full card number, CVV, or raw payment data into prompts, Chatter, handoffs, logs, or generic API calls. If a current customer-owned Maxio payment profile already exists, use maxio_subscription_payment_profile_assignment_preview/apply and verify the subscription profile ID. If a new method is required, use maxio_payment_profile_update_request_preview/apply to send Maxio's secure customer update link, keep the Billing ticket open in the billing queue, and re-check it on the next ticket review. Once the profile is updated, call salesforce_payment_card_ticket_redaction_preview/apply and require fixed-field plus raw-text redaction readback before activation.

For a paid reactivation, after the correct customer-owned payment profile is active on the exact subscription, use maxio_subscription_reactivation_preview/apply. Choose resume_only only when preserving a positive current-period balance is required; otherwise use new_billing_period. The preview requires the exact positive expected charge in cents. Apply makes one provider attempt and downstream activation is allowed only when one new linked successful charge and payment for that exact amount, zero balances, active/trialing state, and the same payment-profile ID all read back. A decline or missing collection blocks retry, returns an opened subscription to canceled, and forbids every Salesforce/Nova activation and ticket closure step. When the Billing ticket instead explicitly authorizes reactivation with no customer charge and one future bill date, use maxio_subscription_no_charge_reactivation_preview/apply. It requires an exactly canceled subscription, zero starting balances, and a waiver equal to the exact current reactivation charge; it issues and consumes one ticket-bound service credit, sets the exact future date, and allows downstream activation only after active state, exact customer identity, zero balances, and the future date read back. It does not require a payment profile or successful payment because customerChargeCents is zero.

For every add/open, close, and reactivation request, resolve the exact official Nova location, Salesforce Account/location and billing structure, Maxio customer/subscription/profile/components, and existing lifecycle orders first. Use the typed Maxio operation for the financial or allocation step; do not activate downstream until the selected paid or explicitly no-charge gate returns downstreamActivationAllowed=true. Then synchronize the Salesforce Billing Account/Schedule and exact location links, create or reuse the required order, and verify its fields through salesforce_billing_account_orders_read. Reactivation and additional-location orders must have no approval ProcessInstance; cancellation orders retain their separate approval disposition. Send any Nova status write to Taylor as one tracked continuation and keep Jamie's parent job active until Taylor returns exact readback.

Agents cannot delete payment profiles, customers, subscriptions, or any other Maxio/Chargify record. Jamie's typed immediate cancellation preserves the subscription and its transaction history while changing state to canceled; it is the only approved use of Maxio's cancellation DELETE endpoint.
For Maxio decline/final dunning behavior, inspect `src/api/maxio_webhooks.py` and `tests/test_maxio_decline_webhook.py`.
Use Rainfall test shape `python -m pytest tests/test_maxio_decline_webhook.py -v` when changing webhook behavior.
Keep tax/legal interpretation separate from Maxio configuration capability.
Do not open the Maxio browser UI merely because a signed-in tab exists. Browser fallback requires a recorded API or connector limitation.
known_notes: Preferred full base URL is CHARGIFY_BASE_URL; CHARGIFY_SUBDOMAIN is an alternative.
Nova site commonly uses novapos.chargify.com; verify from env/vault before API calls.
Documented endpoints include `POST /api/maxio/webhooks/decline` and `POST /api/maxio/billing-health/weekly-report`.

Maxio allocation docs reference `/subscriptions/{id}/allocations.json` and `/subscriptions/{id}/allocations/preview.json`; the broker permits the mutation only through the typed no-credit preview/apply pair.
The four registered subscription-repair modes are discovery guidance over two separate typed mutation pairs. Allocation and manual credit remain separate authorizations and separate verified writes.
Some historical docs mention modules that may not exist in this checkout; verify file existence before importing.

nova_sql.first_action: Use the lane's typed Nova SQL broker for the resolved account. Reads are available to all three business lanes; every mutation routes to Taylor.
safe_actions: Taylor fixed API-customer email cohort read
Taylor guarded cross-account set-based copy preview
Taylor fixed Instyle demo sync preview
Taylor fixed Instyle Runway production merge preview
Taylor fixed Oklahoma HAWAII catalog replacement preview
Taylor INSERT SELECT from approved sources
Taylor UPDATE FROM JOIN against approved sources
Taylor tested typed SQL tool implementation on a guarded GitHub branch
never_allowed: arbitrary ALTER outside the two fixed no-SQL-input feature-column migrations
unbounded UPDATE outside the fixed Instyle orphan crosswalk repair
permanent table creation outside mandatory broker backups or the fixed private Instyle product-map table

options: broker-owned ReadWrite transaction for Taylor execution

fast_start: For invoice spare, below-minimum approval, or SpareInvoiceID questions, call nova_sql_invoice_spare_investigation first with the exact Salesforce-resolved company username and invoice ID. Follow docs/agent-tools/nova-invoice-spare.md, review the complete returned neighborhood, and keep stored facts separate from current-minimum and source-code inference.
Check `agent-sql-toolbox/README.md` before searching OneDrive SSMS folders; reusable account-agnostic scripts live there.
Review `agent-sql-toolbox/schema/pos_schema_preflight.sql` before using toolbox report or migration templates; execute only as an approved read-only SQL inspection.
Use `agent-sql-toolbox/reports/` first for read-only exports and diagnostics.
Use `agent-sql-toolbox/migration/account_clone_preflight.sql` before any account copy/merge/product/location migration work.
The broker resolves Account.Company_Username__c and database credentials internally; agents never receive password fields or connection strings.
All SQL mutation requests are routed to coding_agent even when they originate with Alex or Jamie.

For one exact dbo.Locations RegionId change, call nova_sql_location_region_update first with the exact company username, LocationId, positive RegionId, and source-job idempotency key. It accepts no SQL, reads the row before writing, validates the destination region and reviewed trigger contract, creates a full Locations backup, commits at most once, and performs exact readback. Command Center and Slack route this strict request shape to the same Taylor-owned no-model broker.

For one exact Nova location reactivation, call nova_sql_location_reactivation_update with the exact company username, LocationId, and source-job idempotency key. It accepts no SQL, requires LocationManagerEmployeeID 1 and a positive RegionId, validates the reviewed trigger, creates a full Locations backup, changes only that value to 0, commits at most once, and performs exact readback.

When layaway must be enabled for one or more exact Nova locations, call nova_sql_location_layaway_enable with the Salesforce-resolved company username, the exact LocationId list, and a stable source-job idempotency key. The operation accepts no SQL or setting values. It fixes ExpirationDay=90, IsChangeLayawayExpirationDate=0, MinFirstPayment=10, and Disclaimer='Please come back and ask for our returning customer discount!', fully backs up dbo.Locations_Layaways before any change, upserts only the requested locations, and verifies every row after commit.

For an API-customer recipient list, Taylor must call nova_sql_api_customer_email_cohort. It has no input parameters, applies the fixed unexpired-access/active-account/active-location/email-deduplication policy, and does not send email.

Taylor must call nova_sql_write_preview, then execute the byte-identical plan hash through nova_sql_execute_guarded. For cross-account work, first use nova_sql_data_move_read to establish the exact candidate mapping/count, then include the exact writable company_username and up to eight source_company_usernames in both preview and execute. Use set-based INSERT SELECT, UPDATE FROM JOIN, parameterized filters/ranges, local staging/crosswalks, UPDATE-then-INSERT upserts, and identity_insert=true only when the target identity must be preserved.

For recurring account copies, Alex supplies exact source/target identities, table scopes, match keys, selected columns, and missing logical relationships to Taylor through one tracked handoff. Taylor calls nova_sql_account_copy_preview. The broker discovers current source/target schemas for any eligible business table, omits protected columns, deduplicates source business keys, remaps integer identities through crosswalks, orders parent tables before children, stores an immutable plan, and accepts no SQL. Execute only the returned plan_id with nova_sql_account_copy_execute; use nova_sql_account_copy_status before any retry after uncertainty.

For an authorized table-level recovery from a mounted restore copy, Taylor must call nova_sql_table_restore_preview with the exact Company_Username__c, schema, table, unique key columns, selected non-secret restore columns, and stable idempotency key. The broker alone resolves POS_<company>_RESTORE, uses isolated source/live connections, preserves unmatched rows, rejects unsafe tables/columns, and returns a plan hash. Taylor then calls nova_sql_table_restore_execute only with identical inputs and that exact hash.

For the five approved nullable dbo.Locations columns only, Taylor must use nova_sql_locations_feature_columns_preview and pass its exact plan hash to nova_sql_locations_feature_columns_execute; neither tool accepts caller-supplied SQL.

When the operator says to apply the Kit upgrade to an account, Taylor first resolves the account to one exact Salesforce Company_Username__c, calls nova_sql_kit_upgrade_preview with that username and a stable idempotency key, then passes the identical username/key and exact plan hash to nova_sql_kit_upgrade_execute. The account is the only variable; the broker fixes dbo.Kit, all 15 columns, their types, backup, and verification contract, and accepts no SQL input.

For a disposable validation of the Instyle copy pattern only, Taylor uses nova_sql_instyle_demo_sync_preview and passes its exact hash to nova_sql_instyle_demo_sync_execute. If execute is uncertain or reports execution_failed_reconciliation_required, Taylor calls nova_sql_instyle_demo_sync_status with the same key before any retry. The operation fixes LE_BOUTIQUE_INSTYLE and Instyle_Fragrance as read-only sources and DEMO_NOVA_CAFE as the only writable target. It is not the production route for INSTYLE_RUNWAY.

For the operator-authorized production merge on tickets 347072/347073, Taylor must use nova_sql_instyle_runway_merge_preview and pass its exact hash to nova_sql_instyle_runway_merge_execute. The operation fixes the same two read-only sources and INSTYLE_RUNWAY as the only target, creates two source-group regions and the exact 44-location map, makes full target backups, stores an immutable source-qualified product crosswalk and eleven-row quarantine, and commits only after relationship, count, location, region, history, placeholder, and positive product-orphan validation. If execution is uncertain, call nova_sql_instyle_runway_merge_status before any retry.

For the reviewed Oklahoma HAWAII catalog replacement only, Taylor calls nova_sql_oklahoma_hawaii_catalog_replace_preview with the exact stable key, then passes its exact hash to nova_sql_oklahoma_hawaii_catalog_replace_execute. The operation fixes unique_lifestyle_llc as the read-only source, oklahoma as the only target, and HAWAII as the only category; it accepts no caller-selected destructive scope, rejects any source/target/dependency/count drift, backs up all three target catalog tables, and commits the exact delete-and-copy in one transaction. After uncertainty, call nova_sql_oklahoma_hawaii_catalog_replace_status and never retry blindly. Generic DELETE remains unavailable.

Use the schema-aware account-copy tools for recurring account/table copying. Use the lower-level guarded cross-account executor only for a verified non-copy variation the typed account-copy contract cannot express. Build another typed operation only when neither safe contract can express a required invariant.

The developer broker connection is bound to the exact target, and three-part names are accepted only for explicitly previewed source accounts. Source DML, unlisted databases, linked servers, and tenant-login cross-database access are rejected.

When the authenticated operator explicitly authorizes implementation and release, Taylor previews and merges only the tested scoped-SQL codex/* PR through github_scoped_sql_pull_request_preview/github_scoped_sql_pull_request_merge, waits for the immutable successful Cloud Build, then promotes only that commit through gcp_agent_runtime_release_preview/gcp_agent_runtime_release_apply and verifies it with gcp_agent_runtime_release_status.

The scoped release path independently verifies the active runtime and allows only the same or a newer successful immutable main-branch build. It cannot roll production back, push main directly, edit workflows, administer GitHub, mutate IAM, deploy an unbuilt commit, target another repository or VM, or expose generic GCP mutation.
Before the first permanent UPDATE or INSERT, the executor creates and row-count-verifies a full in-database backup of every target table in the same transaction.
The executor owns the application lock, transaction, temporary-table lifetime, rollback, idempotency receipt, affected-row ceiling, and post-commit readback.
If Taylor's guarded operation is unavailable, report the capability failure; never fall back to a raw/native SQL write.
Do not run table-wide SELECT * unless the user asked for an export; inspect metadata and narrow columns first.
known_notes: Known connection shape was verified in prior ticket exports.
ODBC driver availability is a local machine prerequisite.
Original SSMS scripts are in the user's OneDrive SQL Server Management Studio folders; do not edit originals. Generalize useful copies in agent-sql-toolbox.
Toolbox scripts are diagnostic inputs only. Production mutation is performed solely through Taylor's guarded typed broker.

salesforce.first_action: Use the lane-specific scoped Salesforce MCP. For account-related work, call salesforce_account_360_read first with the strongest known Account, Contact, Location, or ticket identity; for an employee request, reuse the action-owning ticket and call salesforce_ticket_internal_request_post for a real Chatter mention.
safe_actions: fixed Account 360 read with Owner, Nova Account Manager, primary Contact, Contacts, Locations, and tickets
tagged internal employee request preview and duplicate precheck
requires_authorization_for: billing Account flat-rate or lifecycle update
verified cancellation PDF or customer EML upload

required_any: MCP: salesforce_coding_ops or salesforce_support_ops or salesforce_billing_ops

fast_start: Start account-related work with salesforce_account_360_read so the Account, Salesforce Owner, Nova Account Manager, primary Contact, Contacts, Locations, and related tickets are visible from one exact identity. Nova_ID__c is an exact supported identity; if the tool reports ambiguity, select from its candidates rather than guessing or using a fallback Account.

For automated ops-support-email-intake only, Taylor uses salesforce_support_email_ticket_create with the exact Gmail source_email_id and source_key=support-email:<source_email_id> as private broker inputs. The server owns active Ticket_Created_by__c=Darius Parlor, Classic/Wave scope, authoritative non-Demo/test/template/fallback Account eligibility, optional Contact/Location linkage, private-journal idempotency/reuse, and create readback. Gmail/thread/provider/source identifiers never belong in Salesforce ticket fields. Taylor has no generic ticket create; the command-center gateway independently reads the exact live ticket before Alex or Gmail effects.

For automated ops-billing-closure-email-intake only, Jamie inspects the exact staged EML, verifies full-account versus named-location scope against active locations, reuses one matching open request ticket or calls salesforce_billing_closure_email_ticket_create with source_key=billing-closure-email:<source_email_id> as private broker input, then attaches the exact EML through salesforce_account_cancellation_email_attachment_status/upload. Gmail/thread/provider/source identifiers never belong in ticket fields. The intake performs no cancellation, order, Maxio, money, ticket-close, Chatter, or customer-send action. The gateway marks only that Gmail message read after independent ticket and attachment-digest readback.

For monthly billing alignment, Jamie creates or reuses one privately idempotent 3. Billing ticket per Account without storing its idempotency/source key in Salesforce fields and calls nova_billing_locations_read with the exact Company_Username__c before comparing Salesforce or Maxio. Jamie and Taylor can then use salesforce_billing_structure_read, the fake-classification preview/apply pair, the exact location-alignment preview/apply pair, and the Billing Account/Schedule alignment preview/apply pair. Every apply requires the unchanged preview hash, a stable idempotency key, and post-write readback. Taylor cannot create the Billing ticket and does not receive generic order, ticket-record-type, or Salesforce admin writes.

For a full Account close, preserve the exact official Nova active non-storage location IDs, compare them with Salesforce active non-storage rows, and call maxio_location_allocation_reconciliation_read across every current or recently changed subscription. Resolve routine Salesforce administrative or Maxio no-charge/no-credit allocation mismatches with typed preview/apply tools and repeat all three reads before cancellation. Pass the preserved IDs as official_nova_location_ids to the full-account order pair. The union of ticket-linked order location IDs and sum of absolute order location quantities must both equal that official total; order-record count remains one per subscription. Account closure requires the preserved closed_nova_location_ids, an empty current nova_active_location_ids readback, and the exact Maxio reconciliation hash with zero open subscriptions and zero open location components.

Mark or unmark a fake Account only through salesforce_account_fake_classification_preview/apply with the exact Account ID, Nova ID, and linked Billing ticket. Edit an exact location status, zero-or-positive rate, subscription link, or schedule link only through salesforce_billing_location_alignment_preview/apply. When one plan changes lifecycle and billing links, apply stages Status/Bill Amount first, verifies that stage, then clears or assigns only the remaining subscription/schedule links and performs final readback. An Active location without a subscription is allowed only with billing_exception=intentional_free and a zero/empty rate.

Create or repair Salesforce billing bookkeeping through salesforce_billing_structure_alignment_preview/apply. Supply the verified Maxio customer, payment profile, subscription state, schedule amount/start date, and complete Nova location IDs. If a Nova location ID has duplicate Salesforce rows, read both and pass salesforce_location_ids selecting exactly one verified Salesforce record for every requested Nova ID; omission remains fail-closed. For an existing subscription whose canonical Maxio customer already appears on another nonempty schedule-owning Billing Account, pass billing_account_id and billing_schedule_id selecting the exact existing subscription parent. The tool preserves every other schedule owner and its identifier, synchronizes only the selected Billing Account/Schedule and location links, and refuses missing, crossed, duplicate, or partial selectors. A verified scheduleless partial duplicate may still be detached before canonical synchronization.

Use only the registered typed lane tools. Billing lifecycle work uses salesforce_billing_account_read, salesforce_billing_account_locations_read, salesforce_billing_account_orders_read, salesforce_billing_account_flat_rate_update, salesforce_billing_location_rate_update, salesforce_account_cancellation_order_preview/apply, salesforce_location_cancellation_order_preview/apply, salesforce_location_lifecycle_order_preview/apply, salesforce_account_closure_preview/apply, salesforce_account_cancellation_chatter_post, salesforce_account_cancellation_finalize, salesforce_account_cancellation_pdf_status/upload, and salesforce_account_cancellation_confirmation_email_send. Before a Maxio cancellation or allocation decrease, preserve the complete component-deallocation summary and preview hash. Count only location-component deallocations; storage and other components never contribute to a cancellation-order quantity. For partial location closings, pass the exact closed non-storage Salesforce location record IDs to the location cancellation pair after confirming at least one other active location remains. Both cancellation pairs require exact selected location IDs, every selected location to retain a positive Chargify subscription ID, and one exact Maxio evidence row per subscription whose location-component count equals the selected billable locations. The broker derives both the negative numeric order quantity and Contract Name from that location-only count, groups locations sharing a subscription into one NovaPOS order, and creates a separate order for every distinct subscription. Full-account closing uses the same exact selection and does not include all historical Account rows automatically. Generic Salesforce order mutations are blocked for every agent, including Rory. Reactivation and additional-location orders are created only through the lifecycle pair. New Customer Order is forbidden. Reactivations always use the Re-activate an Existing Location record type, populate the exact subscription, compact location IDs, positive quantity, and Billing Start / Stop Date, never enter approval, and never set Reactivation from Decline, Location Reactivated in NovaPOS, or Account Activated in NovaPOS. Within the 3-months is only for a brand-new additional location before Account.CreatedDate plus three calendar months, with Existing_Order_Type__c set to New Location. At or after that cutoff, a new location uses Existing and (New) Additional Customer Order. Terms Agreed is not used for this classification, and no-charge billing treatment never changes it.
